answer_1.quote: Summarizing long narratives is challenging due to the high computational and memory demands required by transformer-based models.

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE and BERTScore as reference points for lexical and semantic similarity... we propose NARRATIVEFACTSCORE (NFS) as a novel metric to measure the factuality of the generated summaries.

answer_4.quote: Our metric demonstrates a statistically strong correlation with human evaluation...
answer_4.guideline: statistical correlation analysis between metric scores and human judgments
